description: This Java class defines a UI widget for a Detached Sensor in a vehicle tuning application. It manages the creation, display, and interaction with a sensor gauge and a mock voltage slider, supporting user interaction and configuration persistence.

classes.name: DetachedSensor
classes.description: A UI component for displaying and manipulating a sensor gauge and mock voltage control, with persistence capabilities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Constructs the DetachedSensor object with specified sensor and width, and initializes GUI components.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the detached sensor window at the location of a mouse event.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Updates the sensor object and UI title when the sensor selection changes.

methods.name: showMockControl
methods.description: Displays or hides the mock voltage slider based on sensor mockability and stimulation mode.

methods.name: isMockable
methods.description: Determines if the current sensor can be mocked based on predefined mockable sensors and stimulation mode.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves the current sensor configuration and window position/size into a given Node object.
